secondary_metrics.coverage: Descriptive in the primary targeted report; paired p-values were not significant.
secondary_metrics.idk_rate: Descriptive abstention-rate comparison; no hallucination/factuality claim is implied.
secondary_metrics.exact_match: 0 for all three systems and therefore non-informative for this benchmark.

interpretation: KG-RAG significantly outperformed both baselines in paired Wilcoxon ROUGE-L tests after Holm correction for the two primary comparisons. The paired effect was moderate versus Vanilla RAG (dz=0.444) and small-to-moderate versus BM25+LLM (dz=0.324). The KG-vs-BM25 bootstrap CI crosses zero, so the inferential evidence should not be overstated. This is a researcher-constructed targeted Aditya-L1 evaluation, not an external independent validation.
method_note: The benchmark is separate from the canonical 180-question ISRO-QA test set. Results were generated with the same local Mistral-7B setup and stored per-question answers.
